command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
[ -f "$change/proposal.md" ] || { echo "$record names change '$change_name', but $change/proposal.md does not exist - write the change there, or name the active change the task is about"; exit 1; }
verdict=$(sed -n 's/^Verdict:[[:space:]]*//p' "$record" | head -1)
if [ "$verdict" != "no-blocking-dependencies" ]; then
  echo "the change record's verdict is '$verdict'; the only verdict that finishes this stage is 'no-blocking-dependencies'."
  echo "If the change IS blocked, do not finish the round: write the dependency chain to the path in \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE as {\"question\": \"...\", \"options\": [\"...\"]}, delete $record and end your turn."
  exit 1
fi

findings.message: Day-length derivation missed in packages/client/src/test/features/home_location/steps/homeLocationWorld.ts:108 (`const dayMinutes = track.maxMinutes + TRACK_STEP_MINUTES;`). With maxMinutes 1439 this gives 1454, so the Here-entry track-day checks (thenTrackDay) will fail. design.md 'Tests that read the old end' names only timeSelectionWorld.tsx and time_selection_day_track.steps.tsx as using `track.maxMinutes + TRACK_STEP_MINUTES`, which is false. Task 5.2 changes only those two files, and task 6.3's catch-all ('fix every remaining scenario that still expects 23:45 or 1425') cannot find a formula with neither literal. Add homeLocationWorld.ts to design D3 and task 5.2 (use TRACK_END_BEFORE_DAY_END_MINUTES).

The spec delta contradicts the proposal on horizontal scrolling. NFR-R1 says 'The page with tracks does not scroll horizontally at 320, 768 and 2560 px', and task 5.4 adds a 768 row tagged @NFR-R1. The MODIFIED 'Day track layout' requirement in specs/time-selection/spec.md still says 'The page with tracks MUST NOT scroll horizontally at 320 px and 2560 px', and its scenario 'Tracks fit narrow and wide screens' says 'at 320 px or 2560 px'. Update the requirement text and the scenario to include 768 px.

design.md Consequences says the 1024 px screenshot re-approval and the 375 px check are done in '(task 5.3)'. In tasks.md that is task 5.5 (Screenshots, NFR-R2); task 5.3 is the E2E time_selection_e2e.feature task. Fix the cross-reference.
